tasks.name: CG-CTX-LEDGER-SSH-INSTALL
tasks.scriptFull:
#!/bin/sh
        set -eu
        USER=cg-context-ledger
        HOME=/volume1/homes/$USER
        mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh" /volume1/scripts
        cat > /volume1/scripts/cg-context-ledger-wrapper.sh <<'WEOF'
        #!/bin/sh
VAULT="/volume1/Capital-Glass-AI-Evidence-Vault"
case "$SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND" in
  "VAULT_SSH_PROBE")
    echo "VAULT_SSH_OK"
    exit 0
    ;;
  "rsync --server "*)
    if command -v rrsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec rrsync -wo "$VAULT"; fi
    exec rsync -l "$VAULT"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "REFUSED: command not in allowlist" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
WEOF
        chmod 755 /volume1/scripts/cg-context-ledger-wrapper.sh
        printf '%s' 'command="sh /volume1/scripts/cg-context-ledger-wrapper.sh",no-port-forwarding,no-X11-forwarding,no-agent-forwarding,no-pty ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIB/ihipX6Clkyoj0ux8/ETqIWgPbzr6+PuawVINl1j66 cg-context-ledger@CG-NIMO-01 (context-ledger replication worker)
' > "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
        chmod 700 "$HOME/.ssh"
        chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
        chown -R "$USER:users" "$HOME/.ssh"
        # Diagnostic-only: passwd shell required for forced-command SSH on DSM; NOT production transport.
        sed -i 's|^cg-context-ledger:.*:/sbin/nologin|cg-context-ledger:x:65537:100::/var/services/homes/cg-context-ledger:/bin/sh|' /etc/passwd || true
        touch "$HOME/.ssh/SSH_INSTALL_OK"
        chown "$USER:users" "$HOME/.ssh/SSH_INSTALL_OK"
